data.description: Intelligently identify file information and organize files based on their context
data.descriptionEn: Intelligently identify file information and organize files based on their context
data.descriptionZh: 智能识别文件信息，根据文件情况整理文件
data.readme:
· Organize files in a specified folder by type, format, time, size, or name.
· Scan and propose an organization plan; files are moved and archived after confirmation, with full preview and undo support.
data.readmeEn:
· Organize files in a specified folder by type, format, time, size, or name.
· Scan and propose an organization plan; files are moved and archived after confirmation, with full preview and undo support.
data.readmeZh:
· 把指定文件夹里的文件按类型、格式、时间、大小或名称整理好
· 先扫描给出整理方案，确认后再移动归档，全程可预览、可撤销
